Welcome
Minn-Kota Ag Products is a Grain Marketing and Production Agriculture Supply Company. We are located in the Southern Red River Valley of Western Minnesota and Eastern North Dakota.
Minn-Kota Ag Products helps area farmers with all of their Chemical, Fertilizer, Seed, and Grain Elevator needs.
GRAIN: 218-643-8464
AGRONOMY: 218-643-6130
2026 Corn and Soybean Harvest Storage
10-Days Free, $.05/Bu/Month
Must Be Priced By August 31, 2027
2026 Wheat Harvest Storage
$.10/bu/month with 10-days free
Beginning Monday, December 8th, 2025 MKAP will be offering free delayed price on soybeans.
Soybeans must be priced or have basis fixed by August 31, 2026 or storage will be charged at $.10/bu/month from unload date .
